page.description: Page number of the results to return. Defaults to 1.

pageSize.description: Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 10. Max value is 1000.

sortField.description: The field to sort the results by. Defaults to name.

sortDirection.description: The direction to sort the results by. Defaults to asc (ascending).

kuery.description: A KQL query string to filter the list of scripts. Nearly all fields in the script object are searchable.
